negative_steps.name: obtain CSRF token for rejected sign-in

blocking_issues: GET / does not contain a CSRF token. The initial token is returned only by GET /api/preauth as JSON field csrf; POST /api/signin sends it in JSON field csrf. After sign-in, state-changing requests send the session CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header.

The full happy path cannot be automated under the stated TOTP rule. POST /api/provision and GET /api/setup-view return only the TOTP shared secret in secret and provisioning URI in uri. No route returns a current mock OTP/currentOtp/mockCode-style value, and POST /api/verify-otp requires a six-digit RFC 6238 TOTP derived from that secret.

Consequently, POST /api/verify-otp cannot be completed by an HTTP test without computing TOTP, which is explicitly disallowed. The subsequent supported routes POST /api/recovery/regenerate and POST /api/recovery/verify cannot be reached on a happy path because account.enabled remains false.
There is no password-change route and no stated new-password policy; new_password is therefore null.
